Process.step01Desc: Browse our catalogue of available dogs, cats, puppies and kittens with full details: breed, age, health, temperament.
Process.step02Desc: Find your ideal companion by filtering by breed, sex, age and European location.
Process.step03Desc: Send a WhatsApp message directly from the profile of the dog you're interested in.
Process.step04Desc: Discuss all the details: health, documents, transport, logistics.
Process.step05Desc: Arrange the arrival of your new companion in the best possible conditions.

WhyChooseUs.item1Desc: Every animal is selected according to strict health, temperament and lineage criteria verified by our team.
WhyChooseUs.item2Desc: Our partner breeders comply with European animal welfare standards and responsible breeding practices.
WhyChooseUs.item3Desc: Health records, pedigrees and full history presented clearly for each animal.
WhyChooseUs.item4Desc: Direct, fast and personalised WhatsApp exchanges to answer all your questions.
